name: How long does it take to install a new basement door frame?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new basement door frame?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a basement door frame installation can vary depending on the complexity of the project. A standard installation, replacing an existing frame in good condition, might take a professional team between 4 to 8 hours. However, if the existing opening requires significant repairs, modifications, or if there are structural issues to address, the process could extend to one or more full days. Factors like the type of frame, accessibility of the basement, and whether new framing is needed also influence the timeline. An accurate estimate is best provided after an on-site assessment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standard basement door frame installation typically takes 4-8 hours. Complex projects with repairs or modifications may take longer, potentially one or more days.
